name: Dividend yield
definition: Annual dividend per share divided by the close price.

name: Close price
definition: The official closing price of the instrument for the trading day.

name: Open price
definition: First traded price of the instrument at the start of the trading day.

name: Bad key
definition: A key holds no spaces or capitals.

name: My close
definition: A second name for the close price.

name: Dividend yield again
definition: The same key twice in one file.
